changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user".user_cards ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID NOT NULL, card_id BIGINT, card_number TEXT, expire_date TEXT, type TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_cards_user_card ON "user".user_cards (user_id, card_id);
